question: In evidence.zip, Use all d99-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Count ELF symbol-table entries whose resolved name is nonempty, across the parsed symbol tables used by the ELF parser. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: readelf -W --syms gf_c_events.bin | awk '/Symbol table .\.symtab./{f=1;next} /Symbol table/{f=0} f && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+:$/ && NF>=8 {print $8}' | wc -l
